tagline: Advancing the Way the World Pays, Banks and Invests
hero_kpi_rationale: FIS is embedding artificial intelligence across its solutions and operations as a key component of its transformation into a platform company, representing a critical competitive advantage in financial technology

kpis.name: AI Integration
kpis.explanation: Embedding of artificial intelligence across solutions and operations
kpis.description: FIS is actively embedding AI across its solutions and operations as part of its transformation into a platform company, representing a strategic priority for competitive positioning

kpis.name: Platform Transformation
kpis.explanation: Shift toward integrated platform model with functional operating structure
kpis.description: FIS is advancing its transformation into a platform company through functional operating model changes, streamlining decision-making and fostering closer collaboration to strengthen competitive position

kpis.name: Strategic M&A
kpis.explanation: Major business restructuring including Worldpay sale and Issuer Solutions acquisition
kpis.description: FIS completed the sale of 55% equity interest in Worldpay Merchant Solutions in January 2024 and entered into definitive agreements to acquire Issuer Solutions from Global Payments in April 2025, demonstrating strategic portfolio optimization

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breach risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the risk factors and is described as fundamental to the company. The language intensity is high, emphasizing multiple attack vectors and potentially severe consequences.

risks.title: Rapid technological change and increased competition
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as a key factor for future success and is linked to innovation and adaptation. The language intensity underscores the need to keep pace with rapid technological changes and competitive pressure.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and data privacy
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights the complex and evolving regulatory environment, particularly regarding cybersecurity and privacy. The language is strong regarding potential consequences (fines, government actions).

risks.title: Dependence on information systems and third parties
risks.score_rationale: This risk relates to failures in information systems, including those managed by third parties. The language intensity emphasizes potential consequences such as service interruptions and data loss.

risks.title: Impact of global economic and geopolitical conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is linked to economic cycles, consumer confidence, and geopolitical conflicts. The language intensity is moderate, but the consequences on demand and profitability are clearly stated.

risks.title: Competition risks from fintech startups and technology giants
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the competition section, specifically mentioning startups and global technology companies as emerging competitors. The language indicates increasing competitive pressure.

ai_positioning.summary: FIS is actively embedding artificial intelligence across its solutions and operations as a key strategic initiative for its transformation into a platform company. The company recognizes AI as fundamental to advancing innovation and competitive positioning in financial technology.
evidence: As we advance our transformation into a platform company, we are embedding artificial intelligence (AI) across our solutions and operations.
